description: This file declares the interface 'IController' which is marked as deprecated and external, providing methods for system control operations such as persistence, reboot, environment querying, configuration management, and cloning within the WPEFramework plugin host namespace.

classes.name: IController
classes.description: An interface for system control operations in the WPEFramework plugin host. It includes methods for persistence, deletion, reboot, environment retrieval, configuration management, and cloning, all marked as virtual for implementation by derived classes.

methods.name: Persist
methods.description: Persists current state or configuration, returning a status code.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes specified resource at the given path.

methods.name: Environment
methods.description: Retrieves environmental information associated with the given index.

methods.name: Configuration (getter)
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration associated with a callsign.

methods.name: Configuration (setter)
methods.description: Sets the configuration for a given callsign.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a clone of a resource with a new callsign.

ctags.name: IController
ctags.pattern: /^struct DEPRECATED EXTERNAL IController : public virtual Core::IUnknown {$/
